_about: Test data for scripts/gate.py, the safety gate that must pass before any release. Coordinates are WGS84 lat/lon. Every place is a town centre moved onto the nearest car road, so Valhalla snaps it cleanly.
_method: Places: the OSM place node of the town (Overpass, maps.mail.ru mirror, OSM data as of 2026-09-25T22:24Z), moved to the nearest vertex of a trunk, primary, secondary, tertiary, unclassified or residential way within 250 m. Stub points: the point on the named OSM way that lies deepest inside the occupied polygon of clip config v1, sampled every 0.5 m (ways fetched from api.openstreetmap.org on 2026-09-26). The ways and the 'driven N m inside' figures come from the navigation research of 2026-09-26, which routed them on the public FOSSGIS Valhalla server before any clip. Version 2 (2026-09-26, after review): every must-fail test has a control leg, a legal point on the approach road at least 600 m from the occupied line and from the state border, which must be routable from the same origin; each control leg was routed on the public FOSSGIS Valhalla server on 2026-09-26 and its shape checked against the v2 no-go area and Georgia's border. The four Russian towns outside Geofabrik's extract are replaced by road vertices 195 to 435 m past the Upper Lars, Mamison, Sadakhlo, Red Bridge and Sarpi crossings, inside the extract. New stub points (84484871, 250174327, 399898439, 480352813) and Kodori targets come from Overpass (overpass-api.de, OSM base 2026-09-25T23:22Z to 23:40Z).

app_request._note: The navigation request the app sends and the checks it runs around it (README, 'What the app must do'). gate.py runs every must-fail test a third time with these settings. Change this together with the app.
